collection.title: Toyota Corolla Hatchback 1983 to 1992 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Toyota Corolla Hatchback 1983 to 1992 requires a 18" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
